metadata.description: 626 Labs plugins: the design system + publishing umbrella (626labs), and the Lab dashboard connection (626labs-lab).

plugins.name: 626labs
plugins.description: 626 Labs design system + publishing umbrella. Two slash-invocable skills: /626labs:design (brand, tokens, UI kit, editorial layer) and /626labs:publishing (studios/works/library/packages router).

plugins.name: 626labs-lab
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to The Lab (626 Labs dashboard) over OAuth: projects, tasks, decisions, deployments and IDE control as MCP tools, plus a skill for repo binding, task briefs and decision logging. Sign in once with /mcp.
